Title:

# **Why Your Videos Die After 48 Hours (How to Fix It)**

In this video, you’ll learn:  
• The truth behind the “48-hour test” and what’s really happening in the algorithm    
• The critical difference between warm and cold audiences    
• How to identify the four performance patterns that kill a video    
• Steps to revive a stalled video or improve your next upload    
• Why a video “dying” is often a symptom, not the final diagnosis
